prompt: A spray of ice shavings from a skate blade stopping on ice, pixel art, plays once, about 0.5 seconds. Tiny white and pale blue ice flecks fly sideways and up from the centre, falling and fading. Colours: white, pale ice blue. message: A 0.5-second, one-shot spray of white and pale-blue ice flecks and short shavings bursting from the centre, flying up and sideways, then falling and fading on a 32×32 transparent canvas. It's tuned to stay inside the frame; the speed, gravity and spread sliders on the page control how far and how high the spray throws.
